question.text: The Incident Response Team (IRT) at a QRTA under CSCRF must include:

answer.text: The compliance officer and auditors exclusively
The Managing Director and the Chief Technology Officer
Junior IT staff to handle operational issues

explanation.text: The Logic: Per workbook p.77, the Incident Response Team at a QRTA under CSCRF must include the Managing Director and the Chief Technology Officer, ensuring top-level management is directly involved in responding to cyber incidents. The Trap: The IRT is not a junior-level team and is not limited to compliance officers, auditors, or external consultants alone. The MD plus CTO requirement applies under the QRTA CSCRF framework rather than to every RTA. Note: The IRT requirement is specific to QRTAs under CSCRF (workbook pp.76-77) and pairs the MD with the CTO at the top of the response chain.
